# scripts/x509_matrix.py: chains made with the OpenSSL CLI, checked at 2026-06-01.
# `## <tag> openssl=<ok or its error number> <case>`, then the driver's line and its answer.
S 
= 1 0 361
## ok openssl=ok valid
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, a wildcard
V 1780272000 6 782e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, an IPv4 address
V 1780272000 6 3139322e302e322e37  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, an IPv6 address
V 1780272000 6 323030313a6462383a3a37  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, RSA-4096 and SHA-512
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, Ed25519
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## x509-expired openssl=10 expired
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -31 x509-expired
## x509-not-yet-valid openssl=9 not yet valid
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -32 x509-not-yet-valid
## x509-name-mismatch openssl=62 the wrong host
V 1780272000 6 6f746865722e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -34 x509-name-mismatch
## x509-name-mismatch openssl=ok no subjectAltName, the host only in CN
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -34 x509-name-mismatch
## x509-name-mismatch openssl=62 wildcard *.com
V 1780272000 6 612e636f6d  
= -34 x509-name-mismatch
## x509-name-mismatch openssl=62 wildcard a.*.b.com
V 1780272000 6 612e782e622e636f6d  
= -34 x509-name-mismatch
## x509-name-mismatch openssl=62 wildcard *.a.b.com against a.b.com
V 1780272000 6 612e622e636f6d  
= -34 x509-name-mismatch
## x509-name-mismatch openssl=62 wildcard across two labels
V 1780272000 6 782e792e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -34 x509-name-mismatch
## x509-key-usage openssl=26 EKU clientAuth only
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -38 x509-key-usage
## x509-key-usage openssl=26 EKU anyExtendedKeyUsage only
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -38 x509-key-usage
## x509-key-size openssl=ok an RSA-1024 key
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -40 x509-key-size
## x509-unsupported-algorithm openssl=ok a P-192 key
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -39 x509-unsupported-algorithm
## x509-unsupported-algorithm openssl=ok signed with SHA-1
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -39 x509-unsupported-algorithm
## x509-critical-extension openssl=34 an unknown critical extension
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -15 x509-critical-extension
## x509-unknown-issuer openssl=20 signed by another key of the same name
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -30 x509-unknown-issuer
## x509-unknown-issuer openssl=18 self-signed
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d 
= -30 x509-unknown-issuer
## x509-unknown-issuer openssl=19 an untrusted root
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d   
= -30 x509-unknown-issuer
## x509-not-ca openssl=79 an intermediate that is not a CA
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -35 x509-not-ca
## x509-key-usage openssl=79 an intermediate without keyCertSign
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -38 x509-key-usage
## x509-path-too-long openssl=25 pathlen 0 exceeded
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d   
= -36 x509-path-too-long
## x509-expired openssl=10 an expired intermediate
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -31 x509-expired
## x509-name-constraint openssl=48 a name constraint excluding the host
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -37 x509-name-constraint
## ok openssl=ok a name constraint permitting the host
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## x509-name-constraint openssl=47 a name constraint permitting another name
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6f746865722e74657374  
= -37 x509-name-constraint
## x509-name-constraint openssl=48 a wildcard under a leading-dot excluded subtree
V 1780272000 6 782e612e6578616d706c65  
= -37 x509-name-constraint
## ok openssl=ok a wildcard above a leading-dot excluded subtree
V 1780272000 6 792e612e6578616d706c65  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 issuer
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## ok openssl=ok valid, RSA-PSS issuer
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= 0 ok
## x509-bad-signature openssl=7 one bit of the signature changed
V 1780272000 6 6c6561662e6578616d706c652e636f6d  
= -33 x509-bad-signature
